title: OpenAgenet / OAN Yellow Paper: Technical Architecture for Trust-Governed Resource Identity and Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2606.03163v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This yellow paper describes the technical architecture of OpenAgenet / OAN. OAN is a protocol-neutral trust layer for open Agent interconnection and discoverable AI resource products. It specifies the role architecture, \texttt{did:oan} identity objects, registration workflow, governance-backed Root lifecycle enforcement, Root-verified package model, authorization-aware Discovery, Root-issued infrastructure authorization VCs, signed trusted invocation, verification requirements, state transitions, security properties, implementation boundaries, and deployment considerations. The design is intended to support heterogeneous Agent frameworks and interaction protocols, including MCP, A2A, ANP-like systems, domain-specific Agent protocols, Skills, MCP Servers, and Tool/API resources. translated_abstract: 本黄皮书阐述了 OpenAgenet / OAN 的技术架构。OAN 是一个协议中立的信任层，用于开放 Agent 互联和可发现的 AI 资源产品。它规定了角色架构、did:oan 身份对象、注册工作流、治理支持的 Root 生命周期强制执行、Root 验证的包模型、授权感知的发现机制、Root 签发的基础设施授权可验证凭证（VC）、签名可信调用、验证要求、状态转换、安全属性、实现边界以及部署考量。该设计旨在支持异构的 Agent 框架和交互协议，包括 MCP、A2A、类 ANP 系统、领域专用 Agent 协议、Skills、MCP 服务器以及工具/API 资源。OAN 并不定义 Agent 之间的全部业务对话或每种资源的原生协议，而是定义资源身份如何成为……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 OAN——一个协议中立的信任层架构，通过 did:oan 分布式身份对象、治理驱动的 Root 生命周期管理、授权感知的发现机制和签名可信调用，为异构 Agent 框架与 AI 资源产品提供可信身份认证与可发现的开放互联能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OAN, a protocol-neutral trust layer architecture that provides trustworthy identity and discoverable open interconnection for heterogeneous Agent frameworks and AI resources through did:oan identity objects, governance-backed Root lifecycle enforcement, authorization-aware Discovery, and signed trusted invocation.
